title: Constant curve assertions assemble over a finite clopen partition
statement: Let Λ be an arbitrary commutative coefficient ring, k an algebraically closed field, f : X → Spec k a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves], and M a Λ-module. Suppose a finite family of pairwise disjoint clopen opens U_i covers X. If the constant M sheaf on each U_i satisfies the eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] relative to U_i → X → Spec k, then the constant M sheaf on X satisfies all eight assertions. No smoothness, connectedness, finiteness or prime-annihilation hypothesis on M is imposed.

theorem assertions_constant_of_isClopen (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsClosed (U i : Set X))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i : Set X) (U j)))
    (hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (H : ∀ i, Assertions Λ ((U i).ι ≫ f)
      ((constantSheaf (U i).toScheme.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    Assertions Λ f ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
